items.name: Orc Knuckle Dagger
items.description: This stout, metal blade of orc design has a horizontal basket hilt with blades jutting from each end, or sometimes one blade like that of a katar.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Half Plate] armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Half-Ear's Luck
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Zdagren takes a critical hit or critically fails a saving throw

Effect The critical hit becomes a normal hit, or the critical failure becomes a normal failure.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Slice
offensiveAbilities.description: Zdagren makes two Strikes against the same target, one with each of his knuckle daggers. Zdagren combines the damage of any attacks that hit and applies precision damage, resistances, and weaknesses only once. Both attacks count toward his multiple attack penalty, but the penalty increases only after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Formation Command
offensiveAbilities.description: Each ally within 30 feet of Zdagren can Step, or Stride up to half their Speed. Each ally can benefit from Formation Command only once per round.
